npcs.name: Boy
lines: I came here with some friends to catch BUG POKéMON!
They're itching to get into some POKéMON battles!

npcs.name: Boy
lines: I was throwing POKé BALLS to catch POKéMON and I ran out.
That's why you can never have too many POKé BALLS.

npcs.name: Lass Ivy
lines: A Butterfree flew past me near the old dead end...
It was huge! Bigger than the ones in the grass. Where does a bug that size hide?

npcs.name: Camper Ned
lines: I keep hearing a buzzing among the trees west of here.
The Bug Catchers say a bug with huge stingers lives there. Nobody has ever caught it.

signs.name: TipsSouth
signs.title: Trainer Tips
lines: TRAINER TIPS
If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, stay out of the grass!

signs.name: TipsSouth5
signs.title: Trainer Tips
lines: TRAINER TIPS
Weaken the POKéMON before trying to catch it! If it's healthy, it may escape!

signs.name: TipsMid
signs.title: Trainer Tips
lines: TRAINER TIPS
For poison, use ANTIDOTE! Buy some at the POKé MART!

signs.name: TipsEast
signs.title: Trainer Tips
lines: TRAINER TIPS
Talk to PROF. OAK on a PC to have your POKéDEX rated!

signs.name: TipsWest
signs.title: Trainer Tips
lines: TRAINER TIPS
You can't catch another person's POKéMON. Throw POKé BALLS only at wild POKéMON!

signs.name: ExitSign
signs.title: Sign
lines: VIRIDIAN FOREST EXIT
PEWTER CITY AHEAD
